mapper.select: SELECT FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
SELECT FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) FOR UPDATE
SELECT ptnr_id::text AS id,ptnr_no AS no,ptnr_nm AS name FROM mst.ptnr WHERE use_yn='Y' AND ptnr_se_cd IN (#{kind},'BOTH') ORDER BY ptnr_nm,ptnr_id
mapper.sql: a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')
mapper.select: SELECT p.prj_nm AS "projectName",d.dev_nm AS "developerName", CASE WHEN d.vndr_ptnr_id IS NULL THEN '자사' ELSE v.ptnr_nm END AS affiliation, a.job_cd AS "jobCode",COALESCE(j.cd_nm,a.job_cd) AS "jobName",a.asgn_rt AS "assignmentRate",a.end_dt AS "endDate" FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN mst.ptnr target ON target.ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr v ON v.ptnr_id=d.vndr_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl j ON j.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND j.dtl_cd=a.job_cd WHERE AND ((target.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') AND p.cust_ptnr_id=target.ptnr_id) OR (target.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') AND d.vndr_ptnr_id=target.ptnr_id)) ORDER BY p.prj_nm,d.dev_nm,a.asgn_id

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.cust_ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')) AS "projectCount", (SELECT count(*) FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.vndr_ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today})) AS "peopleCount"
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.ptnr SET use_yn=#{useYn},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND use_yn <> #{useYn}
mapper.select: SELECT h.chg_at AS "changedAt",h.clmn_nm AS "column", CASE h.clmn_nm WHEN 'ptnr_se_cd' THEN '구분' WHEN 'ptnr_nm' THEN '상호' WHEN 'biz_reg_no' THEN '사업자번호' WHEN 'ptnr_no' THEN '거래처 코드' WHEN 'ceo_nm' THEN '대표자' WHEN 'indty_cd' THEN '업종' WHEN 'chrg_nm' THEN '담당자' WHEN 'chrg_tel_no' THEN '연락처' WHEN 'chrg_email_addr' THEN '담당자 이메일' WHEN 'txinv_email_addr' THEN '세금계산서 이메일' WHEN 'bank_cd' THEN '은행' WHEN 'acnt_no' THEN '계좌번호' WHEN 'dpstr_nm' THEN '예금주' WHEN 'rmrk_desc' THEN '비고' WHEN 'use_yn' THEN '사용 여부' ELSE '등록' END AS "itemName", CASE WHEN h.clmn_nm='acnt_no' THEN right(regexp_replace(h.bfr_val,'[^0-9]','','g'),4) WHEN h.clmn_nm='use_yn' THEN CASE h.bfr_val WHEN 'Y' THEN '사용' WHEN 'N' THEN '중지' ELSE h.bfr_val END ELSE COALESCE(b.cd_nm,h.bfr_val) END AS "before", CASE WHEN h.clmn_nm='acnt_no' THEN right(regexp_replace(h.aft_val,'[^0-9]','','g'),4) WHEN h.clmn_nm='use_yn' THEN CASE h.aft_val WHEN 'Y' THEN '사용' WHEN 'N' THEN '중지' ELSE h.aft_val END ELSE COALESCE(n.cd_nm,h.aft_val) END AS "after", h.data_chg_ty_cd AS "changeType",COALESCE(u.user_nm,'기본 사용자') AS "actorName" FROM sys.data_chg_hist h LEFT JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=h.chg_user_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl b ON b.cd_grp_id=CASE h.clmn_nm WHEN 'ptnr_se_cd' THEN 'PARTNER_KIND' WHEN 'indty_cd' THEN 'INDUSTRY' WHEN 'bank_cd' THEN 'BANK' END AND b.dtl_cd=h.bfr_val LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl n ON n.cd_grp_id=CASE h.clmn_nm WHEN 'ptnr_se_cd' THEN 'PARTNER_KIND' WHEN 'indty_cd' THEN 'INDUSTRY' WHEN 'bank_cd' THEN 'BANK' END AND n.dtl_cd=h.aft_val WHERE h.tbl_nm='mst.ptnr' AND h.obj_rec_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC

SELECT t.ptnr_id::text AS ptnr_id,t.ptnr_no,COALESCE(k.cd_nm,t.ptnr_se_cd) AS ptnr_se_cd,t.ptnr_nm,t.biz_reg_no,t.ceo_nm, COALESCE(i.cd_nm,t.indty_cd) AS indty_cd,t.chrg_nm,t.chrg_tel_no,t.txinv_email_addr, COALESCE(b.cd_nm,t.bank_cd) AS bank_cd,t.acnt_no,t.dpstr_nm, CASE WHEN t.use_yn='Y' THEN '사용' ELSE '중지' END AS use_yn, CASE WHEN t.ptnr_se_cd='VEND' THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD') AND (p.cust_ptnr_id=t.ptnr_id OR (t.ptnr_se_cd='BOTH' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND d.vndr_ptnr_id=t.ptnr_id)))) END AS "projectCount", (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.dev_id) FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE AND ((t.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') AND p.cust_ptnr_id=t.ptnr_id) OR (t.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') AND d.vndr_ptnr_id=t.ptnr_id))) AS "assignmentPeopleCount" FROM mst.ptnr t LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl k ON k.cd_grp_id='PARTNER_KIND' AND k.dtl_cd=t.ptnr_se_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl i ON i.cd_grp_id='INDUSTRY' AND i.dtl_cd=t.indty_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl b ON b.cd_grp_id='BANK' AND b.dtl_cd=t.bank_cd
AND (t.ptnr_se_cd=#{kind} OR t.ptnr_se_cd='BOTH') AND t.use_yn=#{useYn} AND (position(lower(#{q}) in lower(t.ptnr_nm)) > 0 OR replace(t.biz_reg_no,'-','')=replace(#{q},'-',''))
ORDER BY t.ptnr_nm,t.ptnr_id
